decision_rule: Admit M129 for PPO continuation only if fresh behavior retention, zero-response degradation, and strict outcome/wrong-history proof-surface checks all repeat without relaxing the human-view input contract.

the result is treated as ideal-driver completion
hypothesis: M129 improves the combined outcome objective and preserves behavior on two seeds. A formal repeat gate should decide whether it is safe to start PPO continuation or whether the objective is still only a fixed-corpus fit.
success_criteria: wrong-history outcome proof surface remains active
